# Clarity Chat

> Clarity Chat is a React component library for building AI chat interfaces with 200+ components, 95+ hooks, streaming support, RAG, and enterprise features. Built with TypeScript, React 19, and Tailwind CSS.

Clarity Chat provides everything you need to build production-ready AI chat applications in React. From simple chatbots to enterprise-grade conversational AI with memory, RAG, and multi-tenancy support.

## Getting Started

- [Quick Start](/learn/quick-start): Get a working chat interface in 5 minutes with minimal configuration
- [Installation](/learn/installation): Framework-specific installation guides for Next.js, Vite, and Remix
- [Tutorial](/learn/tutorial): Build your first complete chatbot step-by-step
- [Interactive Playground](/playground): Try components live in the browser without any setup
- [Why Clarity?](/learn/why-clarity): Comparison with other solutions and key benefits

## Core Components

- [ClarityChat](/reference/components/clarity-chat): All-in-one chat component with built-in streaming, memory, and theming

- [ChatWindow](/reference/components/chat-window): Container for chat messages with scroll management

- [ChatInput](/reference/components/chat-input): User input with suggestions, attachments, and voice support
- [TypingIndicator](/reference/components/typing-indicator): AI typing/thinking state indicator

## AI-Optimized APIs

Programmatic access to Clarity Chat documentation for AI systems and RAG applications:

- [Components API](/api/ai/components): JSON endpoint with all component documentation
- [Hooks API](/api/ai/hooks): JSON endpoint with all hook documentation
- [Search API](/api/ai/search): Full-text search across all documentation
- [Health API](/api/ai/health): API health and status monitoring
- [OpenAPI Spec](/openapi.json): Full OpenAPI 3.0 specification

### MCP Server

Model Context Protocol server for Claude Code and other AI tools:

```json
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "clarity-chat": {
      "command": "npx",
      "args": ["tsx", "apps/streamlined-docs/mcp-server/index.ts"]
    }
  }
}
```

Available MCP tools: `list_components`, `get_component`, `list_hooks`, `get_hook`, `search_docs`, `health_check`
